proposition.claim:
A collection of cells satisfying conditions1–4 covers K by images of individual closures; no explicit finiteness of A.

B=N=R, smooth submersion f=id, n=1. L=(0,1), compact closure[0,1],K=[0,1]. A=positive integers; a_j=1/2+1/(2j),S_j=(a_{j+1},a_j). Each S_j smooth embedded1-manifold without boundary with compact closure, disjoint images. Boundary strata endpoints; stratum boundary uses frontier closure-minus-stratum convention appropriate to source's cell stratification. Interior endpoints shared by neighboring intervals; only a_1=1 exterior. Identity injective with continuous inverse on cells plus shared endpoints.
